from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationData(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper and the provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper being parsed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers found in this paper's reference list/bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationData]
